text: Tim O'Brien's The Things They Carried was removed from Waukesha classrooms in Wisconsin in 1992 because of “anti-American attitudes, offensive language, political bias, and disturbing fiction.” In 2000 it was challenged at the Pennridge, Pa. high school over its strong language but was retained. In 2006 a board member raised a controversy over the book based on excerpts she had found on the Internet; it was retained on the Northwest Suburban High School District 214 reading list in Arlington Heights, Ill.
meta_description: The Things They Carried by Tim O'Brien: removed from Waukesha classrooms in 1992; challenged but retained in 2000 and 2006.
